key_fiscal_facts.value_text: Qatar uses JV concession model, not PSC. Cost recovery is implicit through JV cost-sharing (QE 75% / IOC 25%). No formal cost oil cap — IOC 25% WI bears 25% costs directly.

35% Corporate Income Tax on petroleum operations (Qatar Income Tax Law 2009, Decree-Law No 21). Applies to IOC share of production from JV concessions. QatarEnergy exempt as state entity. North Field expansion JVs stabilize this rate.

N/A — Qatar uses equity JV/concession model, not traditional PSC profit oil. Al-Shaheen (oil): QatarEnergy 70% / TotalEnergies 30% equity concession. North Field LNG: Incorporated JVs (QatarEnergy 75%, IOC partners 25% combined). Legacy Qatargas PSC expired December 2021; QatarEnergy took 100% equity Jan 2022. Fiscal mechanism is 35% CIT on contractor share + state equity ownership — profit oil concept does not apply.

QatarEnergy holds 70-75% equity in all North Field expansion JVs (mandatory). NFE: QE 75%, TotalEnergies 6.25%, ExxonMobil 6.25%, ConocoPhillips 6.25%, Shell 6.25%. NFS: QE 75%, TotalEnergies 9.375%, ExxonMobil 6.25%, ConocoPhillips 3.125%, Shell 6.25%.
